blocks.p: The *Full or simple* section of *ZeD setup* sets how seven parts of the screen are drawn. For the belt, the devices, the watch and the dashboard, *Full* draws the real thing and *Simple* draws a plain card with the same buttons and readings, in the same order. The action bar, the context menu and the equipped items have choices of their own.

The Full or simple section of ZeD setup.
Figure 61-2
The watch, Simple, left; the belt, Full and Simple, right.

blocks.p: *Full* is the default. The *Access* preset, under *Additions*, picks *Simple* for the devices, the watch and the dashboard.

marks.text: Simple keeps every button and reading. Only the drawing changes.
The watch, plain: the time, the date, the temperature, the speed and the alarm, with the same buttons.

sticky.text: The real thing, or a plain card.

blocks.p: With *Devices* set to *Simple*, every radio, CD player, TV and two-way radio in the *Radio* tab is a plain card: each reading on a row, each button beside it. The ovens, the generator, the grill and the washers and dryers get plain cards the same way. With *Dashboard* set to *Simple*, the dashboard is a plain strip with the speed, the gauges, the lamps as dots and every switch as a button.
